title: Domain Expansion
reviewNotes: Three branches from seven pieces after Rg8 at 107s. Queen capture is actual stalemate; capturing the bishop instead draws; bishop capture-promotion retains a win and selected bishop/knight coordination mates. Earlier eight-piece checks and captured knight remain context.
transcript: Fools will resign. Wise players might make a draw, but only a true genius would be able to [music] win from this position. But not all cards have been dealt in this game because white can play pawn to F7 and now be only one square away from promoting to a new queen. And not only that, since the white pawn has the option of capturing and promoting or just promoting, going behind it is not going to help. This would still be a promotion. And if the king goes back to the corner, since all of the white pieces [music] are on light squares and the black bishop is on a dark square, he actually has no power on this board and there is [music] nothing that this black bishop can do to prevent bishop to B7 checkmate.
